kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Specify which conductors are switched and the required normal and operated states.
copy.zh: 明确开断哪些导体，以及常态与动作后的状态。

copy.en: Confirm whether the assembly carries data, power only or both; connector shape does not establish this.
copy.zh: 确认组件承载数据、仅供电或两者兼有；接口外形不能确定功能。

copy.en: Define voltage, continuous current, inrush and cycle life for the actual switched load.
copy.zh: 按真实负载定义电压、持续电流、浪涌及动作寿命。

copy.en: Set switch position, enclosure dimensions, sealing and supported cable exits.
copy.zh: 安排开关位置、外壳尺寸、密封及出线支撑。

copy.en: Match conductor gauge, insulation and strain relief to the load and handling conditions.
copy.zh: 按负载与操作条件匹配线规、绝缘和应力释放。

copy.en: Agree on/off continuity, voltage-drop and any data-path checks with the intended device.
copy.zh: 结合目标设备约定开断导通、压降及数据通路测试。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

description.en: USB-A to Micro-B switched power-only cable
description.zh: USB-A转Micro-B带开关供电线，不传输数据

description.en: USB-C extension cable with power switch and data wiring
description.zh: 带电源开关及数据接线的USB-C延长线

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: This is the verified subset for the category. The target of 200 finished models and 200 materials remains incomplete.
reason.zh: 此处为本类已核验子集，200个成品型号和200个材料料号的目标仍待继续补充。
